title: EAM ExpMod
description: Experimental test mod for EAM, a cross-version/cross-platform/no-installation loader
body:
This is an experimental mod for EAM, a cross-version/cross-platform/no-installation loader. When we get to it, we'll add more blocks and items (but specifically more ways to expose our internal mods more special features, like the Tool Gun / x86 emulator.)

To test this, you will need Java 25, and a way to input the JVM flag below:
```
-javaagent:<EAM JAR location>="-mod_type=minecraft -mod_arg=-version=<version #>"
```
NOTE: entering `-help` on the agent's parameters, or under `-mod_arg` will not allow the game to start, and will only print the local help / flags. The string to enter under the version argment is whatever is specified for a file on this site.

Please report any issues you have while running to our GitHub.
